title: GTA 6: Lucia Texts Jason While Gunmen Take Over 😳
youtube_title: GTA 6: Lucia Texts Jason While Gunmen Take Over 😳
youtube_description:
GTA 6 shows Lucia's texts on screen, live. In Rockstar's An Extended Look (from 23:00), masked men with rifles take over a company's opening party. Jason creeps through a dark office, and a text from Lucia pops up on screen: "GUYS EVERYWHERE". Then we see Lucia hiding among the guests, typing: "10+ guys, auto weps, explosives, sound military..." while a gunman walks up a few steps away. Rockstar says the Extended Look was captured entirely from in-game footage on the PlayStation 5.

Would you send that text, or stay hidden?

Sources (Rockstar Games, read Nov 24, 2026):
- Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look, August 27, 2026, 23:00 to 24:05 ("Captured entirely from in-game footage on the PlayStation 5"): https://www.rockstargames.com/VI/an-extended-look
- Grand Theft Auto VI, out November 19, 2026: https://www.rockstargames.com/VI

The text bubbles on our drawn phone are our own redraw of what the Extended Look shows on screen. We don't know yet how texting works for the player in this scene.

Trailer clips: Rockstar Games (GTA VI: An Extended Look), used for commentary. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two.
